# Beagle v0.25.2

Beagle v0.25.2 is the cleaned product checkpoint for Beagle as an independent,
file-authored, statically typed Lisp derived from Clojure. It keeps the useful
compiler and Store machinery while moving the separate proposition-first
language thesis into Clause instead of forcing two languages into one product.

## Changed

- Source files and their checked AST are again Beagle's program authority.
  Beagle Store remains optional durable tooling for terms, triples, history,
  queries, provenance, and caches rather than a second language authority.
- Clojure, JavaScript, and Nix are the primary hosted profiles. Native Core is
  retained as an explicit experimental system-layer path with separately
  selected C17, QBE, and C17/WASI Wasm materializers.
- Unconsumed semantic-authority experiments were removed from the live product
  tree. Their history remains recoverable in Git while Clause develops the new
  language independently.

## Fixed

- Clojure output now implements the portable `utf8-encode` contract, and
  imported qualified union variants retain their nominal checker types.
- Native Core adds focused fail-closed coverage for integer literals, recursive
  short-circuiting, distinct collections, sorting, artifact linking, and
  driver selection without promoting Native into the hosted release contract.
- The Racket freshness gate separates the production compiler closure from the
  test closure, avoiding unnecessary test-module compilation in ordinary
  check and build loops while retaining the complete gate for tests.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tompassarelli/beagle/compare/v0.25.1...v0.25.2
